description: Most versions sit where no built-in manager looks (Helm values, kustomize remote URLs,
script variables, workflow env blocks), and a version Renovate cannot see silently stops
being updated. Each manager teaches one comment dialect marking such a pin; three, because
the version appears as a value, in a release-asset URL, or in a raw.githubusercontent URL.
Annotations need an explicit depName=; the inferred-name form in Renovate's docs matches

customManagers.description: '# renovate:' -- the version is the value on the next line (Helm values, env vars, script constants). A trailing @sha256 digest is captured as currentDigest, never as part of the version: swallowed into currentValue it made a digest-pinned value look unpinned (so pinDigests offered to re-pin it) and unsortable.
'# renovate-gh-release-asset:' -- the version is a path segment of a github.com/.../releases/download/vX.Y.Z/ URL, so it cannot be matched as a value
'# renovate-gh-raw-url:' -- same problem for raw.githubusercontent.com/.../vX.Y.Z/ URLs, which is how the bootstrap CRD copies pin upstream manifests
